name: Property Core

repository.note: The public repository. Grok clones it only to read the chosen flow's guide and these files. It never runs anything from the clone.

services.name: Cleaner Core
services.choice: Cleaner Core: a cleaner for a property

services.name: Supply Core
services.choice: Supply Core: supplies reordered for a property

services.name: Tour Core
services.choice: Tour Core: self-guided tours for a rental unit
services.parked: Not offered to new accounts. Only Saad makes an account a touring account, on /admin.

integrations.name: Property Core
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 discovered from the hosted service. The host signs in or types the invite code from Saad on the approval page and clicks Allow. Grok cannot approve itself. One connection serves every flow.

integrations.name: Google Calendar
integrations.auth: The host connects their own Google account to Grok's built-in Google Calendar connector. Grok reads the events and passes them to Cleaner Core. Cleaner Core never gets a Google approval.

integrations.name: Grok shopping and Vault
integrations.auth: The host's own Grok shopping tools and Vault. Saved cards, Shop Pay, Link, and X Money stay in the host's Vault. Supply Core never sees them.

integrations.name: Google Drive
integrations.auth: The host connects their own Google account to Grok's built-in Drive connector, for Tour Core's portable backups only.

routines.name: Cleaner Core Check
routines.schedule: Every 5 minutes for a demo, and hourly otherwise.

routines.name: Supply Core Check
routines.schedule: Daily at the check time the host picked (10:00 unless they chose another).

ships: the bot profile and standing instructions, which name the repository and the hosted address
the seven Tour Core skills, kept for touring accounts while touring is parked
neverShips: any routine's webhook address or key
live booking, cleaning, order, or tour records
marketplace.activation: A host adds the bot from the team template link and says Set up Property Core, or pastes the prompt into a new bot. It connects to hostedPropertyCoreUrl/mcp, the host signs in or types their invite code from Saad and clicks Allow, then adds a property and picks Cleaner Core, Supply Core, or both for it. Each routine is created during setup for the flows turned on. They never run a server.
